title: Samurai Doge / Oriental Cheems (3 moods) [4K]
description:
A remade of this memorable art piece of this samurai shiba with some features:

— Totaly removed all the fixed leaves and petals floating on the scene to add only procedural flying ones.
— RePainting of some sectors to recreate a bigger scene in better proportion for Hi-resolutions.
— Added some unfocused bushes in the front to bring deep on the scene
— Added some Different moods for Cheems, no more crying. Mood Quiet will be the dog without crying, and Chilling the same but coolest. (is just a little branch on the mouth, Im lazy)
— Sun Lights and fog effects because I can.

ENJOY IT !!

Original Artwork: galopes.artstation.com/projects/rAGoB5
"I just want to be happy..."
